visual_description: The image displays a pyramid-shaped diagram composed of blue rectangular blocks arranged in four hierarchical levels, each containing white text labels. The top level has one block labeled “Implement the Strategies and Evaluate Progress.” The second level contains two blocks: “Develop the Implementation Plan” on the left and “Develop the Evaluation Plan” on the right. The third level includes three blocks: “Develop a Shared Vision,” “Develop Strategic Goals and Objectives,” and “Develop the Strategic Plan,” from left to right. The base (fourth) level consists of four blocks: “Assess the Target Population,” “Perform a Self-Assessment,” “Develop a Niche,” and “Develop Program Outcomes,” also from left to right. All text is clearly legible; no axes, tables, or numerical data are present. The layout visually suggests a foundational-to-executive progression, with broader activities at the bottom narrowing
